what: Arista Networks makes the high-speed network switches and software that connect servers inside cloud and AI data centres, and increasingly corporate campus networks.
customers: Cloud giants above all (Microsoft and Meta are its largest customers), plus enterprises and financial firms.
money: switches and routers running its EOS software
moat: One software system (EOS) across all its hardware, a reputation for reliability and deep ties with the biggest cloud builders.
risks: Reliance on a few very large customers
opportunities: Revenue grew about 29% last year and about 27% a year over three years
Operating margin of 43% with no debt and $14 billion of cash
AI clusters need the high-speed Ethernet switching it specialises in
watch: Revenue from the largest cloud customers and AI networking orders.
